blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Personalizing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as intelligent assistants has recently emerged as an active research topic, where an MLLM is expected to go beyond generic, one-size-fits-all replies, and instead generate responses grounded in user-specific objects, entities, and concepts encountered during interactions. Nevertheless, existing studies mainly focus on personalizing MLLMs on a static, predefined set of personalized concepts and require users to manually and frequently extend this set to accommodate newly emerging concepts, which is infeasible in dynamic-world scenarios. To address this limitation, we recast conventional MLLM personalization as an Open-Set problem, and propose TAME-O, the first long-context open-set personalized MLLM assistant. Specifically, TAME-O introduces a training-free, plug-and-play Concept Reconciliation Skill (CR Skill). It enables the assistant to automatically unlock novel concepts during prolonged human-MLLM interactions while preventing confusion with previously unlocked ones, allowing the MLLM to continually grasp more and more concepts and progressively refine the modeling of known ones. Extensive experiments under the open-set personalization setting underscore the efficacy of our method.
blocks.zh: 将多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)作为智能助手的个性化,最近作为一个积极的研究课题出现,其中MLLM预计将超越通用的,一刀切的回答,取而代之的是基于用户特定对象、实体和互动中遇到的概念的响应. 尽管如此,现有的研究主要侧重于将MLLMs个性化,放在一套静态的,预先定义的个性化概念上,并要求用户手动并经常地扩展这一套,以适应新出现的概念,这在动态世界情景中是不可行的. 为解决这一限制,我们将常规的MLLM个性化改编为"开放-Set"问题,并提议TAME-O,这是第一位长文开放-个性化的MLLM助手. 具体来说,TAME-O引入了无培训,插接和游戏的概念调和技能(CR Skill). 它使助理能够在人类-MLLM长期互动期间自动解锁新概念,同时防止与以前解锁的概念相混淆,使MLLM能够不断地抓住越来越多的概念并逐步完善已知概念的模型化. 在开放的个性化设定下进行的广泛实验突出了我们方法的功效.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Imagine a future intelligent assistant that, through prolonged interactions, can not only remember you, but also gradually uncover and internalize your personal entities that are never specified in advance: your blue cup, and your yellow puppy Timi.
When the assistant “sees” these entities in later conversations, it can visually recognize them and generate “personalized responses” that are grounded in the appropriate contexts, rather than one-size-fits-all answers.
blocks.zh:
想象未来一个聪明的助手, 通过长时间的相互作用, 不仅可以记住你, 而且还可以逐渐发现和内部化你的个人实体 这些从未事先说明: 你的蓝杯, 还有你的黄狗蒂米.
当助理在以后的谈话中“看”这些实体时,它可以目视地认出它们,并产生“个性化的反应”,这些反应以适当的背景为基础,而不是一刀切的答案。

blocks.en:
All these imaginations are closely tied to the research field of multimodal large language model (MLLM) personalization Alaluf et al. (2024) ; Nguyen et al. (2024) ; Kim et al. (2025) ; Hong et al. (2026) , which aims to enable general-purpose MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5 OpenAI (2025) , Qwen3.5 Qwen Team (2026) ) to understand user-specific concepts, also referred to as ‘‘personalized concepts’’ 1 1 1 In this work, we use the terms “concept”, “personalized concept”, and “user-specific concept” interchangeably. (e.g., Bob’s dog), instead of treating them as generic objects.
Most existing studies, such as MyVLM Alaluf et al. (2024) and R2P Das et al. (2025) , focus on the capability of MLLMs in visual identification of personalized concepts, followed by a simple substitution of the corresponding concept in the output generation.
Nevertheless, such static applications are overly simplified and fail to cater to real-world demands, where user-MLLM interactions are prolonged and dynamic, and dialogues become more complex due to extended contexts.
As a remedy, TAME Hong et al. (2026) explored long-context personalized dialogues with MLLMs by modeling long- and short-term attribute shifts of each concept over time, enabling the personalization experience to progressively improve over extended human-MLLM interaction.
blocks.zh:
所有这些想象都与多式联运大语言模型(MLLM)个性化Alaluf等人(2024年)、Nguyen等人(2024年)、Kim等人(2025年)、Hong等人(2026年)的研究领域密切相关,后者旨在使通用的MLLMs(如GPT-5 OpenAI (2025年)、Quen Team (2026年))能够理解用户特有的概念,也称为“个性化概念”1 1 在这项工作中,我们使用“概念”、“个性化概念”和“用户特有的概念”等术语互换。 (例如Bob的狗),而不是把它们当作一般物品。
大多数现有的研究,如MyVLM Alaluf等人(2024年)和R2P Das等人(2025年),都注重MLLMs在个性化概念的视觉识别能力,然后在输出生成中简单替代相应的概念.
尽管如此,这种静态应用程序过于简化,无法满足现实世界的需求,因为用户-MLLM互动时间长,动态不断,由于环境的扩大,对话变得更加复杂.
作为补救办法,TAME Hong et al. (2026年)探索了与MLLMs的长篇个性化对话,对每个概念随时间推移的长篇和短篇属性变化进行模型化分析,使个性化经验能够比扩展的人类-MLLM互动逐渐改善.

blocks.en:
However, all existing methods, including TAME, can only operate under the closed-set personalization setting :
the MLLM is personalized on a fixed and static set of user-specific concepts that are manually predefined by the user.
In real-world scenarios, users frequently encounter new personalized concepts Hao et al. (2025) ; Das et al. (2025) , and this rigidity severely undermines the flexibility of existing methods, which require users to frequently register the “novel personalized concepts” for the MLLM by hand (cf. Figure 1 (a)).
In contrast, an ideal MLLM assistant should gradually unlock more and more novel personalized concepts automatically during continued human–MLLM interaction, while progressively refining the modeling of previously known concepts.
We term this capability Open-Set MLLM Personalization , an appealing property for MLLM assistants in the dynamic world (cf. Figure 1 (b)).
blocks.zh:
然而,所有现有方法,包括TAME,只能在封闭式个人化设置下运作:
MLLM被个性化于一组固定和静态的用户特定概念上,这些概念由用户手动预定义.
在现实世界中,用户经常遇到新的个性化概念Hao等人(2025年);Das等人(2025年),这种僵硬性严重损害了现有方法的灵活性,这就要求用户经常用手为MLLM登记“个性化概念”(见图1(a))。
相比之下,理想的MLLM助手应当在人类-MLLM持续互动期间自动解锁更多和更多新的个性化概念,同时逐步完善以前已知概念的模型化.
我们把这种能力称为Open-Set MLLM个性化(Open-Set MLLM Personalization),这是动态世界中MLLM助手的吸引力财产(见图1(b))。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Paradigm comparison between (a) Closed-Set Personalization, where the MLLM passively acquires novel concepts from user provision, and (b) Open-Set Personalization, where the MLLM actively grasps new concepts from everyday interactions.
blocks.zh: 图1:将(a)闭合-Set个性化,MLLM被动地从用户提供中获取新概念,(b)开合-Set个性化,MLLM从日常互动中积极把握新概念的比较.

blocks.en:
To achieve open-set personalization, the core challenge lies in enabling the MLLM assistant to reliably resolve newly emerging personalized concepts with existing ones over extended, long-context interactions.
On one hand, when novel personalized concepts are misidentified as existing ones, the assistant may accumulate erroneous contexts for the existing concepts.
On the other hand, misclassifying an existing user-specific concept as novel not only prevents the assistant from leveraging accumulated contexts during generation, but also leads to concept fission , where an existing concept is erroneously forked into two or more concepts.
blocks.zh:
为了实现开放的设定个性化,核心挑战在于使MLLM助理能够可靠地解决新出现的个性化概念与现有概念之间的长期、长期互动。
一方面,当新的个性化概念被错误地认定为现有概念时,助理可能为现有概念积累错误的背景.
另一方面,错误地将一个针对用户的现有概念归类为新概念,不仅阻止了助理在一代人期间利用累积的环境,还导致概念裂变,一个现有概念被错误地推入两个或两个以上的概念.

blocks.en:
To address these two symmetric problems, we draw
upon the insight that
user-specific concepts (e.g., visual appearance)
evolve over time.
As a result, the past dialogues that are temporally proximal to the current interaction often provide more reliable cues for identification than distant history.
Accordingly, when comparing a newly appearing concept with those grasped from past dialogues, more recent memories should be emphasized for robust concept maintenance.

为了解决这两个对称的问题,我们画

随时间演变。
因此,过去的对话在时间上与当前互动关系密切,往往比遥远的历史更可靠地提供识别线索。
因此,在将新出现的概念与从以往对话中掌握的概念进行比较时,应强调较新的记忆,以维持强有力的概念。

blocks.en:
To this end, we propose TAME-O , the first O pen-set, long-context personalized MLLM assistant that can automatically TAME novel user-specific concepts as they appear during ongoing interactions,
beyond a predefined closed-set of concepts.
TAME-O endows the MLLM assistant with a novel training-free Concept Reconciliation Skill ( CR Skill )
that mediates between incoming concepts and stored knowledge.
Specifically, the CR Skill equips the MLLM with a new Time-Aware Dynamic Memory ( TAD Memory ), which stores personalized concepts along with their associated attributes extracted from past interactions, where each attribute is associated with a temporal marker to reflect when it was observed.
Subsequently, when a concept is involved in the current interaction, the CR Skill retrieves candidate relevant concepts from the TAD Memory by considering concept attributes in a temporally weighted manner , prioritizing memories closer to the current interaction.
These retrieved candidates, together with the current user query and recent dialogue contexts, are jointly reasoned by the MLLM to determine whether the concept aligns with an existing one or represents a new concept, enabling the assistant to effectively grasp novel user-specific concepts while continuously refining unlocked ones.
The CR Skill is designed to be flexible and can be readily integrated into existing personalized MLLM assistants (e.g., TAME) in a plug-and-play way, granting them open-set personalization capability in the dynamic world.
We list our contributions as follows: • We formalize the problem of Open-Set MLLM Personalization, moving beyond static concept dictionaries to enable continuous, autonomous concept acquisition in dynamic environments. • We propose TAME-O, the first open-set, long-context personalized MLLM assistant.
TAME-O introduces a novel plug-and-play CR Skill that can be integrated into existing MLLM assistants to activate their open-set capability, automatically managing the lifecycle of personalized concepts by detecting the new and refining the old. • Experiments on both existing LCMP-H and LCMP-O, a dedicated benchmark for open-set MLLM personalization newly constructed in this study, showcase the efficacy of TAME-O.
Code is provided at https://github.com/ronpay/TAME-O .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
MLLM Personalization. MLLMs have been widely adopted as assistants, while most mainstream models still operate under a one-size-fits-all paradigm, treating all users as interchangeable and failing to adapt to individual identities, preferences, or interaction histories Kim et al. (2025) ; OpenAI (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025) ; An et al. (2025) ; Nguyen et al. (2025) ; Nie et al. (2026) .
MyVLM Alaluf et al. (2024) and Yo’LLaVA Nguyen et al. (2024) pioneered the concept of MLLM personalization, which enables an MLLM with generic knowledge to respond to user visual queries in a personalized manner.
They achieved personalization by training a set of parameters to visually memorize each concept An et al. (2024) ; An et al. (2026) .
To alleviate the frequent retraining for each newly emerging concept, studies such as RAP Hao et al. (2025) , PVIT Pi et al. (2025) , R2P Das et al. (2025) , and PLVM Pham et al. (2025) explored memory-based or tuning-free mechanisms, where a set of user-predefined personalized concepts is first stored in memory, and an incoming concept is then treated as a query to visually match against these stored concepts for personalized response generation.
However, all these methods primarily focus on the visual identification of personalized concepts, that is, recognizing an object in an image as user-specific and replacing a generic object reference with the corresponding personalized concept name for captioning or single-turn question-answering.
Such overly simplified settings fail to meet real-world requirements, where human–MLLM interactions are persistent and highly contextualized, and personalization must account for complex dependencies from extended interaction history rather than isolated, static inputs.
To remedy such limitation, TAME Hong et al. (2026) proposed the first long-context MLLM personalized assistant, which fosters MLLM to capture the variations in both long- and short-term attributes of user-specific concepts.
Nevertheless, existing methods (including TAME) are limited to only responding to a manually predefined set of user-specific concepts and fail to adapt to dynamic real-world settings.
In contrast, we propose TAME-O , which activates Open-Set Personalization capability through a training-free, plug-and-play Concept Reconciliation Skill (CR Skill), which effectively and autonomously unlocks novel personalized concepts while avoiding potential conflicts with previously “memorized” ones.
The additional literature reviews for memory-augmented LLM and open-set recognition are in Appendix G .

blocks.en: 3 Methodology: TAME-O
blocks.zh: 3个 方法:TAME-O

blocks.en:
Revisiting TAME. We begin by re-formalizing the pipeline of TAME Hong et al. (2026) , the first long-context personalized MLLM assistant.
TAME considers a continuous stream of human–MLLM interactions: 𝒮 = ⟨ 𝒬 1 , 𝒬 2 , … , 𝒬 i , … ⟩ \mathcal{S}=\langle\mathcal{Q}_{1},\mathcal{Q}_{2},\ldots,\mathcal{Q}_{i},\ldots\rangle ,
where each 𝒬 i \mathcal{Q}_{i} denotes an atomic single-turn vision–language dialogue occurring at time step i i , consisting of a user query q i q_{i} and the corresponding assistant response a i a_{i} .
When responding to q i q_{i} , the MLLM assistant is required to leverage the potential contexts from the past dialogues tied to the personalized concept appearing in 𝒬 i \mathcal{Q}_{i} : a i = Φ MLLM ​ ( q i , π ⁡ ( ⟨ 𝒬 1 , 𝒬 2 , … , 𝒬 i − 1 ⟩ ) ) a_{i}=\Phi_{\text{MLLM}}(q_{i},\pi(\langle\mathcal{Q}_{1},\mathcal{Q}_{2},\ldots,\mathcal{Q}_{i-1}\rangle)) , where π ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \pi(\cdot) denotes a context extraction strategy that filters out relevant information for current concept from the interaction history.
To achieve this, TAME endows the assistant with double memories, a static memory ℳ S \mathcal{M}_{S} and a dynamic memory ℳ D \mathcal{M}_{D} , which are designed to maintain the long-term and short-term attributes of personalized concepts from past dialogues, respectively.
Each memory stores items as a tuple ( Cid , Attr ) (\texttt{Cid},\texttt{Attr}) , where Cid is the concept identifier that is used to uniquely identify a personalized concept, while Attr denotes an attribute extracted from a specific dialogue turn.
Subsequently, when facing an incoming personalized concept, TAME first identifies its corresponding concept identifier Cid , and then aggregates the memory items (attributes) that are marked with the same Cid from ℳ S \mathcal{M}_{S} and ℳ D \mathcal{M}_{D} to support personalized response generation.

blocks.en:
However, TAME implicitly assumes a closed-set personalization setting, where a set of N N user-specific concepts is predefined and fixed throughout the interaction: 𝒞 = { c 1 , c 2 , ⋯ , c N } \mathcal{C}=\{c_{1},c_{2},\cdots,c_{N}\} , where 𝒞 \mathcal{C} is the static concept set.
When encountering a novel concept c N + 1 c_{N+1} , TAME requires the user to manually initialize this concept and provide the corresponding concept identifier for proper memory management.
Consequently, such a setting is ill-suited to dynamic real-world scenarios, where new personalized concepts frequently arise, and requiring users to explicitly specify concept identifiers introduces significant overhead and undermines usability.

blocks.en:
Paradigm of TAME-O. To address this challenging setting, TAME-O provides existing personalized assistants with a novel training-free and plug-and-play Concept Reconciliation Skill (CR Skill), which handles novel concepts while mitigating potential conflicts with existing ones.
Specifically, TAME-O first equips the MLLM assistant with a Time-Aware Dynamic Memory (TAD Memory), which captures variations of personalized concepts in a temporally annotated manner (cf. Section 3.1 ).
Subsequently, when a new interaction occurs, the CR Skill evaluates the incoming concept against memory items using a temporally weighted matching strategy, and provides a set of candidate concepts to the MLLM for final resolution of this concept (cf. Section 3.2 ).
We further provide an example of integrating the CR Skill into the existing personalized assistant TAME (cf. Section 3.3 ).
Finally, we discuss potential concept fission issues and present corresponding mitigation solutions (cf. Section 3.4 ).
The framework of TAME-O is in Figure 2 .

blocks.en: 3.1 Time-Aware Dynamic Memory
blocks.zh: 3.1 实时动态内存

blocks.en:
We consider that after time step i − 1 i-1 , the personalized concepts that have been identified by the MLLM assistant are represented as a dynamic concept set 𝒞 i − 1 = { c 1 , c 2 , … , c K i − 1 } , \mathcal{C}_{i-1}=\{c_{1},c_{2},\ldots,c_{K_{i-1}}\}, where K i − 1 K_{i-1} denotes the number of personalized concepts discovered up to time step i − 1 i-1 .
Given a new dialogue 𝒬 i \mathcal{Q}_{i} , a simple approach to determining whether a novel personalized concept appears is to compare the information of the concept extracted from a i a_{i} against the grasped concepts in memory.
However, in the long-context interactions, the information (also referred to as attributes) of each concept often varies over time Hong et al. (2026) .
Consequently, early attributes of a concept may become outdated and unfaithful for depicting such concept, whereas more recent attributes can better reflect its current state.

blocks.en: 3.3 Plug-and-Play Operation
blocks.zh: 3.3 插管和管道操作

blocks.en:
We take the integration of TAME-O (i.e., the training-free CR Skill) into TAME as an example.
Specifically, we retain TAME’s static memory ℳ S \mathcal{M}_{S} while replacing its dynamic memory ℳ D \mathcal{M}_{D} with TAD Memory ℳ T \mathcal{M}_{T} .
After obtaining the determined concept identifier Cid ∗ \texttt{Cid}^{*} in 𝒬 i \mathcal{Q}_{i} in Eq. ( 6 ), if the concept is an existing one , the assistant leverages this identifier to locate relevant memory items from both memories, and aggregates the corresponding information for personalized response generation (following the original TAME pipeline).
If the concept is determined to be novel , a new identifier will be assigned to this concept and stored in the TAD Memory, therefore unlocking new concept automatically .
Notably, when integrated with TAME, we also incorporate information from the static memory for candidate concept retrieval.
The final similarity score for each candidate concept is obtained by averaging the similarity scores from the static memory and the TAD Memory.

blocks.en:
Benchmarks. Since open-set personalization is inherently intertwined with long-context dialogues, we first adopt an existing long-context personalized MLLM benchmark LCMP-H Hong et al. (2026) , which consists of 30 personalized concepts (Pet (10), Object (10), and Person (10)), 420 historical dialogue turns, 720 personalized images, and 180 hard questions.
In addition, we introduce a new benchmark tailored for long-context open-set personalization, termed LCMP-O .
Compared with LCMP-H, LCMP-O poses a more challenging open-set scenario by incorporating a larger number of personalized concepts (45 concepts) with more visually similar appearances .
Specifically, its concepts are evenly split into Pet (15), Object (15), and Person (15), where pets and objects are organized into groups of three concepts sharing the same breed or object class, and persons are selected with similar ages and an approximately 1:1 gender ratio.
Following LCMP Hong et al. (2026) , we generate 10 historical dialogue turns for each concept to reveal its long-term attributes and short-term events, as well as 5 hard questions requiring reasoning over both types of attributes.
Overall, LCMP-O contains 450 historical dialogue turns, 675 personalized images, and 225 hard questions, with more details in Section C.2 .
blocks.zh:
基准。 由于开放式的个性化与长文本对话有着内在的交织,我们首先采用了现有的长文本个性化的MLLM基准LCMP-H Hong等人(2026年),由30个个个性化概念(Pet(10),Object(10)和Person (10)),420个历史对话转折,720个个个个性化图像,180个硬问题组成.
此外,我们引入了一个针对长文开放个人化的新基准,称为LCMP-O。
与LCMP-H相比,LCMP-O提出了更具挑战性的开放设置情景,将更多的个性化概念(45个概念)纳入其中,其外观更为视觉相似。
具体地说,它的概念均匀分为Pet(15),Object(15)和Person(15),其中宠物和物品被组织成三个概念组,共用同一个品种或物品类,并且选择年龄相近,性别比大约为1:1.

总体而言,LCMP-O包含450个历史对话转折,675个个性化图像,225个硬问题,详见C.2节.

blocks.en:
Open-Set Personalization Setup. To reflect the open-set setting, we adopt a concept-incremental evaluation protocol .
Specifically, personalized concepts are introduced to MLLMs sequentially rather than all at once.
For each concept, the MLLM is first exposed to its associated historical dialogues in a temporally sequential manner , one dialogue turn at a time step 3 3 3 We define time steps globally across concepts, where each dialogue turn constitutes a time step. .
After all dialogue turns for the concept have been processed, the MLLM is instantly evaluated on the corresponding QA set tied to that concept.
Moreover, in contrast to Hong et al. (2026) , the concept identifiers of historical dialogues under the open-set setting are not provided to the assistant.
Instead, the assistant is required to autonomously and incrementally unlock new concepts.

Open-Set个人化设置. 为了反映开放式设置,我们采用了概念递增评价协议。
具体地说,个性化的概念是按顺序而不是同时引入MLLMs的.
对于每个概念,MLLM首先以时间顺序接触相关的历史对话,一个对话在步骤3 3 3 中转动。 我们在全球界定各种概念的时间步骤,其中每个对话都构成一个时间步骤。 。 。 。

此外,与Hong等人(2026年)相比,开放设置下的历史对话的概念标识不提供给助理.
相反,要求助理自动和逐步解锁新概念。

blocks.en:
Baselines. We first compare TAME-O against several state-unaware MLLM personalization baselines, including Backbone (the native MLLM without personalization adaptation), MyVLM Alaluf et al. (2024) , Yo’LLaVA Nguyen et al. (2024) , RAP Hao et al. (2025) , PeKit Seifi et al. (2026) , and R2P Das et al. (2025) .
Notably, we do not apply the open-set setting to these baselines, as their state-unaware design prevents them from directly supporting unlocking novel concepts automatically across interactions.
In addition, we construct a new open-set personalization baseline, TAME † , by extending the long-context baseline TAME Hong et al. (2026) with a simple retrieval-based concept unlocking and resolution mechanism.
Specifically, TAME † retrieves candidate concepts from the memory and treats the Top-1 retrieved concept as the matched existing concept, if its similarity exceeds a predefined threshold.
Otherwise, the concept is considered novel.
We further experiment with TAME † w/ MLLM decision (i.e., the w/o TAD Memory variant in Table 2 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Open-Set Personalization Performance
blocks.zh: 4.1 开放式个人化 业绩

blocks.en:
From the results in Table 1 , we observe that: (O1) Training-based methods, such as MyVLM and Yo’LLaVA, perform poorly on both benchmarks, as encoding long-context personalized information with a limited number of lightweight parameters is insufficient to capture extended interaction histories.
In contrast, RAG-based, training-free methods such as R2P and PeKit achieve stronger performance by storing personalized concepts in external memory while keeping model parameters fixed.
However, all these baselines operate under a closed-set assumption and lack the ability to automatically incorporate novel personalized concepts. (O2) TAME is the SOTA baseline for long-context personalization.
However, under the open-set setting, TAME † exhibits suboptimal performance, since simply treating all historical attributes equally fails to identify appropriate matched concepts.
Moreover, the concept fission problem further undermines the effectiveness of TAME † .
In contrast, TAME-O achieves the best performance for two reasons: the CR Skill accurately reconciles incoming personalized concepts by treating the stored concept attributes in a temporally weighted manner, emphasizing the most recently observed concept information.
Moreover, the PCF Strategy further stably fuses fissioned concepts, mitigating the concept fission problem and enabling the better localization of sufficient contextual information for each concept.
Furthermore, Figure 4 shows that TAME-O maintains stable and effective open-set personalization performance as the total number of concepts continually increases.

相比之下,基于RAG,无训练的方法,如R2P和PeKit,通过在外部内存中存储个性化概念,同时保持模型参数固定,实现了更强的性能.
然而,所有这些基线都是在封闭式假设下运行的,缺乏自动纳入新的个性化概念的能力. (O2)TAME是长文本个性化的SOTA基线.
然而,在开放设置下,TAME 的性能表现不佳,因为简单地对待所有历史属性都未能找到适当的对应概念。
此外,概念裂变问题进一步损害了TAME 的效能。

blocks.en:
Ablative Analysis. We conduct comprehensive ablations on the core components within TAME-O, with results in Table 2 .
For CR Skill , we evaluate the variants: (1) w/o TAD Memory , where the Time-Aware Dynamic (TAD) Memory is reduced to a static memory and all temporal markers associated with concept attributes are removed; (2) w/o MLLM Decision , where the Top-1 retrieved concept is directly treated as the matched concept if its similarity score exceeds a predefined threshold, and otherwise regarded as novel; (3) w/o CR Skill , where both the TAD Memory and the MLLM-based decision mechanism are removed, and a simple time-unaware retrieval strategy is applied, with the Top-1 retrieved concept always selected as the matched existing concept if it exceeds a predefined threshold.
We observe that variants (1)–(3) exhibit clear performance drops, indicating that the accurate reconciliation of novel and existing user-specific concepts is vital for open-set personalization.
For PCF Strategy , we entirely remove it to design a variant: w/o PCF Strategy .
We observe that this variant incurs a clear performance drop, as the degree of concept fission becomes increasingly severe over time without any mitigation,
leading to memory chaos.

blocks.en:
Concept Fission and Fusion Analysis. We quantitatively evaluate the severity of the concept fission and how well TAME-O mitigates the fission problem.
Specifically, we report the Concept Fission Rate (CFR), as defined in Eq. ( 11 ), over time steps on the historical dialogues of LCMP-H and LCMP-O.
From Figure 5 (a)–(b), we observe that the CFR of TAME † rapidly reaches 47.8% and 73.3% on LCMP-H and LCMP-O and then remains high, while that of TAME-O w/o PCF Strategy gradually increases.
Nevertheless, TAME-O w/o PCF Strategy has a much lower CFR than TAME † , since the CR skill mitigates concept fission at its source by more accurately reconciling incoming open-set personalized concepts with existing ones.
From Figure 5 (c)–(d), we observe that with the PCF strategy equipped, the CFR never exceeds that without it and finally drops from 17.8% to 13.2% (LCMP-H) and from 22.0% to 13.8% (LCMP-O), indicating that the PCF strategy effectively fuses potentially forked concepts.
Moreover, we empirically observe that the PCF Strategy performs fusion with relatively high accuracy, achieving a strong fusion success rate (cf. Appendix E for details).
blocks.zh:
概念任务和融合分析。 我们从数量上评估裂变概念的严重程度,以及TAME-O如何缓解裂变问题。
具体地说,我们报告Eq.(11)中定义的概念任务率(CFR),随着时间的推移,报告LCMP-H和LCMP-O的历史对话步骤。
从图5(a)-(b)中可以看出,TAME的CFR在LCMP-H和LCMP-O上迅速达到47.8%和73.3%,然后仍然很高,而TAME-O w/o PCF战略则逐渐增加。
尽管如此,TAME-O W/o PCF 战略的CFR比TAME 低得多,因为CR技能通过更准确地将即将到来的开放的个性化概念与现有概念相协调,在源头减轻概念裂变。
从图5(c)-(d)中,我们观察到,由于配备了PCF战略,CFR从未超过这一战略,最终从17.8%降至13.2%(LCMP-H),从22.0%降至13.8%(LCMP-O),这表明PCF战略有效地将潜在的推敲概念融为一体。
此外,我们经验性地观察到,聚变战略的核聚变准确度相对较高,实现了强的聚变成功率(详见附录E)。

blocks.en:
Robustness to Concept Confusability. Since visually similar personalized concepts are where open-set reconciliation is most likely to fail, we further break down the performance on LCMP-O by concept confusability.
Specifically, we measure the confusability of each concept by its nearest-neighbour similarity to the other concepts, computed with the same encoder and text-plus-visual similarity score as the PCF Strategy (Eq. ( 7 )), and split the 45 concepts into three equal-sized tertiles (Low, Mid, and High).
As shown in Figure 6 , TAME-O outperforms TAME † on every metric in every similarity bin, with CRA gains of 32.9–52.2 points.
Moreover, TAME-O maintains relatively stable performance as concept confusability increases, keeping its CRA above 60 even in the most confusable bin.
In contrast, the CRA of TAME † already drops sharply at medium similarity, as its threshold-based Top-1 matching is easily misled by similar concepts.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this study, we pioneered the research in long-context MLLM personalization into the open-set setting.
To this end, we proposed TAME-O, which automatically tames novel personalized concepts from everyday interactions while resolving potential conflicts with previously memorized ones.
Extensive experiments in the open-set setting on LCMP-H and LCMP-O benchmarks demonstrate that TAME-O effectively integrates incoming personalized concepts even under visually similar concepts, mitigates concept fission, and remains robust to varying concept arrival orders.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们率先将长文本MLLM个性化的研究引入了开放设置中.
为此,我们提出了TAME-O,它从日常互动中自动将新的个性化概念驯化,同时解决与以前记忆中的潜在冲突。
在LCMP-H和LCMP-O基准的开放式设置中进行的广泛实验表明,TAME-O即使在视觉上相似的概念下也有效地融合了即将到来的个性化概念,缓解了概念裂变,对于各种概念到达命令仍然很强.

The PCF Strategy is executed periodically every T T interaction steps, rather than at every step.
At each execution, the strategy computes pairwise similarities between personalized concepts to identify potentially forked ones.

blocks.en:
Since open-set personalization is studied in long-context, real-world human–MLLM interactions, rather than in static and overly simplified settings (e.g., personalized image captioning), we first adopt the hard version of the LCMP benchmark (Long-Context MLLM Personalization) [ 4 ] , a recent benchmark and the only available benchmark specifically designed for long-context MLLM personalization.
Below we propose a detailed description of this benchmark.
blocks.zh:
由于开放设置个性化研究于长文本,现实世界的人-MLLM交互,而不是静态和过于简化的设置(如个性化图像字幕),我们首先采用了硬版的LCMP基准(Long-Context MLLM个性化)[4],这是最近的一项基准,也是专门为长文本MLLLM个性化设计的唯一可用基准.
下面我们提出对这一基准的详细描述。

blocks.en:
LCMP is the first benchmark for evaluating personalized multimodal large language models in long-context interactions.
It consists of 30 personalized concepts, including Pet (10), Object (10), and Person (10), along with approximately 420 historical dialogue turns, 240 easy questions, 180 hard questions, and 720 personalized images, and includes two evaluation sets:
(1) LCMP-E , which contains easy VQA questions involving a single type of attribute (either short-term or long-term), and
(2) LCMP-H , which contains hard questions requiring reasoning over both types of attributes.
It measures an assistant’s ability to perceive and model variations in both short-term and long-term attributes of user-specific concepts and to generate contextually appropriate responses based on extended dialogue histories.
LCMP is constructed through three stages:
(1) personalized concept creation, where raw images are sampled and endowed with fine-grained temporal attributes;
(2) multi-turn vision–language dialogue generation, which simulates historical interactions that reveal concept attribute changes over time;
and (3) evaluation question generation, which produces single-turn VQA tasks requiring reasoning over the preceding dialogue context.
The benchmark thus explicitly tests long-context reasoning and personalization beyond static single-turn tasks.
We adopt the hard version of the LCMP benchmark, namely LCMP-H, in this study for evaluation.
As illustrated in Figure 9 , we provide cases of personalized concepts from LCMP-H.
blocks.zh:
LCMP是在长文互动中评价个性化的多式联运大语言模型的第一个基准.
它包括30个个性化概念,包括Pet(10)、Object(10)和Person (10),以及大约420个历史对话回合、240个简单问题、180个硬问题和720个个性化图像,并包括两套评价:
(1) LCMP-E,包含简单VQA问题,涉及单一类型的属性(短期或长期),以及
(2) LCMP-H ,它包含了硬性的问题,要求对两类属性进行推理.
它衡量助理人员是否有能力察觉和模拟用户特定概念的短期和长期属性的变化,并根据扩展的对话历史产生适合具体情况的反应。
LCMP通过三个阶段构建:
(1) 个性化概念创造,即原始图像取样并具有精细的时间属性;
(2) 多回合愿景-语言对话生成,模拟历史互动,揭示概念属性随时间而变化;
和(3)评价问题生成,产生单回合VQA任务,需要对前一次对话背景进行推理.
因此,该基准明确测试了长文本推理和个人化,超出了静态单回合任务。
我们在本研究报告中采用了LCMP基准的硬版,即LCMP-H,以供评估。
如图9所示,我们提供了LCMP-H的个性化概念案例。

blocks.en: C.2 Benchmark: LCMP-O
blocks.zh: C.2 基准:LCMP-O

blocks.en:
To comprehensively evaluate the open-set MLLM personalization capability of the MLLM assistant, we construct a new benchmark: O pen-Set L ong- C ontext M LLM P ersonalization ( LCMP-O ).
The original LCMP benchmark exhibits two limitations in evaluating open-set personalization performance: (1) LCMP contains a small number of personalized concepts, which constrains the diversity of the open-set evaluation. (2) The personalized concepts in LCMP are characterized by highly distinctive attributes, making it relatively easy for MLLMs to differentiate new concepts from previously grasped ones, softening the challenges of open-set personalization.
blocks.zh:
为了全面评估MLLM助理的开放式MLLM个人化能力,我们构建了一个新的基准: O 笔-Set L ong-C 上文本 M LM P 个人化(LCMP-O ).
最初LCMP基准在评价开放设定个性化性能时表现出两个局限性:(1)LCMP包含少量个性化概念,限制了开放设定评价的多样性. (2)LCMP中个性化概念的特点是具有高度独特的属性,使得MLLMs比较容易区分新概念和以前掌握的概念,软化了开放设置个性化的挑战.

blocks.en:
Taking the above limitations into consideration, we construct LCMP-O with 45 personalized concepts, deliberately designed to present high intra-class visual similarity and thus pose stronger challenges for open-set personalization evaluation.
Following the construction pipeline of LCMP [ 4 ] , we generate 10 historical dialogue turns and 5 hard evaluation questions per concept, yielding a total of 450 dialogues and 225 evaluation questions.
blocks.zh:
考虑到上述限制,我们用45个个个性化概念构建了LCMP-O, 刻意提出高等级内视觉相似性,从而对开放的个性化评价构成更严峻的挑战。
在LCMP [4] 的建设管道之后,我们产生了10个历史对话回合和5个每个概念的硬评价问题,共产生了450个对话和225个评价问题。

blocks.en:
The 45 concepts span three types, each chosen to maximize within-type visual ambiguity:
(1) 15 Pets (cats, dogs, and rabbits), where every three concepts belong to the same breed, making fine-grained visual disambiguation particularly challenging. These cats and dogs concepts are sourced from the Oxford-IIIT-Pet dataset [ 21 ] , which covers 37 breeds with substantial intra-breed variation in pose, lighting, and deformation. And the rabbits concepts are collected by authors.
(2) 15 Persons, sampled from subjects of similar age with an approximately 1:1 gender ratio. Person images are drawn from MS-COCO [ 22 ] , following the same protocol as TAME [ 4 ] .
(3) 15 Objects, where every three concepts belong to the same object class.
These concepts are sourced from PerVA [ 17 ] , which contains object concepts that exhibit high visual and semantic similarity.
In Figure 13 , we provide cases of concepts from the LCMP-O benchmark.

45个概念分为三类,每一类都是为了尽量扩大类型内视觉模糊:

blocks.en: C.3 Baselines
blocks.zh: C.3 基线

blocks.en:
Since open-set MLLM personalization is novel as a setting, we compare TAME-O with traditional closed-set MLLM personalization baselines and a specifically designed baseline for the open-set setting.
For traditional baselines, we select MyVLM [ 1 ] , Yo’LLaVA [ 2 ] , RAP [ 8 ] , PeKit [ 17 ] , and R2P [ 7 ] , with detailed descriptions as follows: • MyVLM pioneers the personalization of general VLMs so they can understand and talk about concepts unique to a given user.
It augments LLaVA [ 23 ] with external concept heads that first detect a target entity and then inject a learned concept embedding into the model’s mid-level features, guiding the decoder to mention the concept naturally. • Yo’LLaVA frames subject personalization as learning a compact representation from only a few example images.
It encodes the subject into a small set of latent prefix tokens that sit between the vision encoder and LLaVA’s language decoder, binding visual attributes to text without touching backbone weights. • RAP turns a generic MLLM into a user-aware assistant by adding an external memory layer. A key–value store “remembers” user facts and portraits, a multimodal retriever selects the most relevant keys at inference, and the generator conditions on both the query and retrieved context to tailor its answer. • PeKit argues that strong personalization can be achieved entirely at inference time. It pairs off-the-shelf visual descriptors with retrieval-augmented generation and lightweight visual prompts, injecting the correct identity or object instance into any MLLM decoder without gradient updates. • R2P shows that an MLLM can personalize itself using nothing but its pre-trained weights and a clever retrieval stack. It distills each personalized concept into a sparse fingerprint of discriminative attributes, retrieves candidate fingerprints at run time, and employs chain-of-thought reasoning to verify them before generation.

blocks.en:
For open-set personalization method, we additionally create a competitive baseline TAME † , a modified variant of the long-context MLLM personalized assistant TAME [ 4 ] .
TAME is the first long-context MLLM personalization method that explicitly models both the long-term and short-term variations of personalized concepts and retrieves reliable contextual information for each concept to support personalized response generation.
We unlock the open-set capability of TAME by retrieving the most relevant concept stored in memory based on the visual and textual information in the query.
A predefined similarity threshold is then applied: if the retrieved similarity exceeds the threshold, the concept is classified as existing; otherwise, it is treated as novel.
We conduct a search over the threshold in the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] with an interval of 0.1 0.1 , and select the best-performing value of 0.6 0.6 for all experiments with TAME † .

我们通过根据查询中的视觉和文字信息检索存储在内存中最相关的概念,解锁TAME的开放设置能力.
然后适用预先定义的相似性阈值:如果检索到的相似性超过阈值,则将概念归类为已有;否则,则视为新颖.
我们在[0, 1] [0, 1] 范围内的阈值上进行搜索,间隔为0.1 ,并选择最佳性能值为0.6 0.6,用于TAME 的所有实验。

We adopt the latest released MLLMs Qwen3.5-9B [ 6 ] , and InternVL3.5-8B [ 18 ] , as the MLLM backbone.
Since TAME-O is a plug-and-play framework, we adopt TAME as the base personalized assistant for evaluation.
When identifying the concept in user’s query, we first prompt the MLLM to extract open-set category descriptions from the query, and then use the extracted categories to perform grounding on the query image with Grounding-DINO [ 19 ] .
In addition, we adopt the Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B [ 20 ] to generate embeddings for both visual and textual inputs.
For the CR Skill, we set the temporal decay coefficient λ \lambda to 1, the number of candidates K K to 3, and the number of latest memory items for each concept R R to 3.
For PCF Strategy, we set the time interval T T to 10, the number of fusion candidates L L to 3 3 , and the threshold τ \tau to 0.6 0.6 .
For the CFR metric in Eq. ( 11 ), we set ϵ \epsilon to 1.

blocks.en:
Since TAME-O is designed as a training-free and plug-and-play framework, we further evaluate its scalability by integrating it with other personalized MLLM assistants beyond TAME [ 4 ] (reported in the main paper).
Specifically, we integrate TAME-O with two representative training-free, RAG-based personalization methods, PeKit [ 17 ] and R2P [ 7 ] , which differ in their memory organization and retrieval strategies.
To enable open-set personalization, we augment both methods with our Concept Reconciliation (CR) Skill and a Time-Aware Dynamic (TAD) Memory that stores dialogue contexts with temporal markers.
The CR Skill is used to determine whether an incoming personalized concept is novel or previously observed, while the original memory mechanisms of each method are retained for concept-specific storage and retrieval during response generation.
As illustrated in Table 5 , we compare the performance of these two baseline methods under the open-set setting by integrating TAME † and TAME-O, respectively.
We observe that integrating TAME-O yields superior open-set personalization performance, demonstrating the strong scalability and generality of our method.

blocks.en: Appendix G Additional Literature Review
blocks.zh: 附录G 文学评论

blocks.en: G.1 Memory-Augmented LLMs
blocks.zh: G.1 内存强化LLMs

blocks.en:
Recent research on LLMs explores augmenting models with external memory to store and retrieve past interactions, enabling improved adaptability without parameter updates [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] .
Existing studies typically organize memory as structured summaries, temporal events, or reasoning traces to highlight key information while reducing redundancy [ 27 , 28 ] .
To scale memory usage, retrieval mechanisms are introduced to efficiently locate relevant past experiences, often embedding memory entries as dense vectors and retrieving the most relevant ones via similarity search [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] , with cosine similarity and vector indexing tools such as FAISS commonly used in practice.
These studies demonstrate that external memory can effectively extend LLM capabilities without retraining by enabling models to accumulate and reuse past knowledge.
blocks.zh:
近期对LLMS的研究探索了用外部内存来存储和检索过去相互作用的增强模型,使得在不更新参数的情况下改进了适应性[24,25,26].
现有研究通常组织内存作为结构化摘要,时间事件,或推理痕迹,以突出关键信息,同时减少冗余[27,28].
为了扩大内存的使用范围,引入了检索机制,以高效定位相关过去的经验,经常将内存条目嵌入为密集的矢量,并通过相似性搜索[29,30,31]检索最相关的内存,并带有余弦相似性和矢量索引工具,如实践中常用的FAISS.
这些研究表明,通过使模型能够积累和再利用过去的知识,外部记忆可以有效扩展LLM能力而无需再培训.

blocks.en:
Building upon these advances, memory-based methods have also been studied in MLLM personalization, eliminating the need for frequent retraining for novel concepts [ 8 , 4 ] .
Unlike general memory-augmented LLM approaches that treat each memory entry independently, these methods explicitly maintain concept-level memory units to organize information around individual personalized concepts.
Approaches such as RAP [ 8 ] and PeKit [ 17 ] store user-specific concepts in external memory and perform retrieval-based matching, while R2P [ 7 ] introduces structured “fingerprints” with reasoning for identification.
More recently, TAME [ 4 ] extends the memory for concept storage to the modeling of long-context information for each user-specific concept.
However, these methods generally assume a closed-set of predefined concepts and fail to extend the memory autonomously by the MLLMs for accommodating novel concepts.
In contrast, our TAME-O introduces a time-aware dynamic memory with explicit concept reconciliation, enabling continuous concept acquisition and refinement under open-set, long-context interactions.
Moreover, the PCF strategy further refines the memory to mitigate excessive concept fission that could otherwise lead to severe memory chaos.
blocks.zh:
在这些进展的基础上,还在MLLM个性化中研究了基于记忆的方法,从而不再需要对新概念进行频繁的再培训[8,4].
与独立处理每个内存条目的一般内存增强LLM方法不同,这些方法明确维持概念级内存单元,以组织围绕个人个性化概念的信息.
RAP[8]和PeKit[17]等方法在外部内存中存储用户特有的概念并进行基于检索的匹配,而R2P[7]引入了结构化的"指印",并附有识别的推理.
最近,TAME [4]将概念存储的内存扩展到每个用户特定概念的长文本信息的建模.
然而,这些方法一般假定了一套封闭的预先定义的概念,未能通过MLLMs自动扩展内存以适应新概念.
与此相反,我们的TAME-O引入了具有明确概念调和的具有时间意识的动态内存,使得能够在开放的设定,长的文字交互下持续获得和完善概念.
此外,PCF战略进一步完善了记忆,以减轻过度的概念裂变,否则会导致严重的记忆混乱.

blocks.en: G.2 Open-Set Recognition
blocks.zh: G.2 开放式确认

blocks.en:
Open-set recognition (OSR) addresses the limitation of the closed-set assumption in traditional deep learning systems, enabling models to both classify known classes and detect inputs belonging to previously unseen classes [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] .
The problem was first formally introduced by [ 34 ] , who proposed a binary SVM-based framework for training and evaluation.
Since then, extensive research has been devoted to this area.
Existing approaches can be broadly divided into discriminative and generative methods.
Discriminative approaches aim to learn more robust representations or decision boundaries to reduce overconfidence on unknown classes, such as placeholder-based representative points, supervised contrastive learning, and diverse representation regularization [ 35 , 36 , 37 ] .
In contrast, generative approaches synthesize instances near the boundary between known and unknown classes using techniques such as GANs, variational autoencoders, or prototype-based modeling to better characterize open space risk [ 38 , 39 , 40 ] .
blocks.zh:
开放设置识别(OSR)解决了传统深层学习系统中封闭设置假设的限制,使模型既能对已知的班级进行分类,又能检测属于先前未见的班级的投入[32,33,34].
这个问题首先由[34]正式提出,他提出了一个基于二进制SVM的培训和评价框架.
从那时起,对这一领域进行了广泛的研究。
现有方法大致可分为歧视性方法和遗传性方法。
歧视性做法旨在学习更强有力的表述方式或决定界限,以减少对未知类别(例如基于占位者的代表性点、监督的对比性学习和多样化的代表性正规化)的过度信心[35、36、37]。
与此相反,基因方法利用诸如GANs、变异自编码器或基于原型的模型等技术,将已知和未知类别之间的界限附近的情况合成,以便更好地描述开放空间风险[38、39、40]。

blocks.en:
Despite the name “open-set,” these methods are primarily designed to identify whether an input belongs to an unknown category, typically labeling it as unknown.
In contrast, the open-set personalization setting considered in this work requires not only identifying novel user-specific concepts, but also assigning them new personalized concept identities, enabling the assistant to continually expand and refine the set of personalized concepts during interaction.
blocks.zh:
尽管名称是“open-set”,但这些方法主要是为了确定一个输入是否属于一个未知的类别,通常将其标注为未知。
与此相反,本作中考虑的开放式设定个性化设定,不仅需要识别用户特有的新概念,还需要赋予这些概念新的个性化概念身份,使助理能够在互动过程中不断扩展和完善成套个性化概念.

blocks.en: G.3 Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: G.3 多种大型语文模式

blocks.en:
Large Language Models (LLMs), built upon extensive world knowledge, have rapidly advanced across a wide range of domains [ 41 , 42 ] .
Building on this foundation, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently emerged by integrating language decoders with multimodal encoders, enabling LLMs to perceive and reason over diverse data modalities [ 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 , 47 , 48 , 49 , 50 , 51 ] .
Among MLLMs, vision–language models have been extensively studied [ 5 , 18 ] , and the fusion of visual and linguistic modalities has driven significant progress in applications such as Visual Question Answering (VQA) [ 52 ] , multimodal medical analysis [ 53 ] , and autonomous driving [ 54 ] .
With these advances, MLLMs are increasingly regarded as reliable human assistants, supporting users in various aspects of daily life.
Despite their success, mainstream MLLMs are primarily trained for general-purpose scenarios and fail to adapt to individual users’ preferences and personalized contexts [ 1 ] .
To bridge this gap, recent studies have begun to explore personalized MLLM assistants [ 2 , 15 , 4 ] .
Among them, MC-LLaVA [ 13 ] extends personalization to multiple concepts via multi-concept instruction tuning, and CaT [ 14 ] synthesizes training data to strengthen personalized VLMs, while both still operate on a predefined set of concepts.
In this work, we take a step further by addressing the open-set personalization setting and propose the first open-set personalized MLLM assistant TAME-O, which better aligns with users in open-world, long-term interactions.
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMS)建立在广泛的世界知识之上,在广泛的领域迅速发展[41,42].
在此基础上,最近出现了多式联运大语言模型,将语言解码器与多式联运编码器结合起来,使LLMs能够对多种数据模式进行感知和解释[43、44、45、46、47、48、49、50、51]。
在MLLMs中,视觉-语言模型被广泛研究[5,18],视觉和语言模式的融合带动了视觉问答[52],多模式医学分析[53],自主驾驶[54]等应用的重大进展.
随着这些进步,MLLMs越来越被视为可靠的人手助手,在日常生活的各个方面支持用户.
尽管成功,但主流的MLLMs主要接受通用情景培训,无法适应个别用户的偏好和个性化背景[1].
为了弥补这一差距,最近的研究已经开始探索个性化的MLLM助手[2,15,4].
其中MC-LLAVA[13]通过多概念指导调谐将个性化扩展到多个概念,CaT[14]合成培训数据以加强个性化的VLM,而两者仍然在一套预先定义的概念上运作.
在这部作品中,我们进一步解决了开放的设定个性化设置,并提出了第一个开放的设定个性化的MLLM助理TAME-O,在开放的世界长期互动中更好地与用户配合.

blocks.en: G.4 Large Language Model Personalization
blocks.zh: G.4 大语言模型个性化

blocks.en:
Large Language Model (LLM) personalization [ 55 , 56 , 57 , 58 , 59 ] focuses on adapting an LLM’s responses to a single user’s preferences, interaction history, and persona characteristics (e.g., a preference for concise responses).
Early efforts such as PersonaMem [ 60 ] introduce benchmarks with numerous simulated profiles to test whether models can leverage dialogue history to infer user preferences and deliver personalized responses.
PersoBench [ 57 ] further explores persona-aware dialogue generation in a zero-shot setting.
Building upon these evaluations, methods like PLUM [ 56 ] employ dialogue-based data augmentation to fine-tune LLMs for more consistent user-aware behavior.
PALACE [ 61 ] advances this line with a topic-aware retrieval mechanism that extracts relevant cues from extended histories and a persona-driven prompt learning module for multi-session adaptation.
Nevertheless, LLM personalization focuses on tailoring a model’s responses to a single user’s preferences, dialogue history, and persona traits (e.g., preferring concise answers).
In contrast, MLLM personalization emphasizes enabling personalized conversations grounded in user-related multimodal concepts, such as the user’s pets, friends, and frequently mentioned objects.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLM)个性化[55,56,57,58,59]侧重于调整一个LLM的响应,以适应单个用户的偏好,互动历史,和人物特征(例如,倾向于简洁的响应).
PersonaMem [60] 等早期工作引入了许多模拟剖面的基准,以测试模型是否能够利用对话历史来推断用户的喜好并给出个性化的响应.
Perso Bench [57] 在零镜头设定下进一步探索人意识对话生成.
基于这些评价,PLUM [56] 等方法采用基于对话的数据增强,以微调LLMS,使其更加一致的用户意识行为.
PALACE [61] 推进了这条线,建立了一个专题认识检索机制,从扩展的历史中提取相关提示,并建立了一个由人驱动的多会场适应快速学习模块。
尽管如此,LLM个性化侧重于根据一个单一用户的偏好,对话历史和人物特征(例如更喜欢简洁的答案)来定制一个模型的响应.
相反,MLLM个性化强调基于用户相关多式联运概念,如用户的宠物、朋友和经常提到的对象的个性化对话。

blocks.en: Appendix K Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录K 限制

blocks.en:
Reliance on External Modules. TAME-O relies on off-the-shelf grounding and embedding models to localize and retrieve personalized concepts, and their errors may propagate to concept reconciliation.
Nevertheless, these modules can be readily replaced by stronger ones as they become available.
blocks.zh:
依赖外部模块。 TAME-O依靠现成的地面和嵌入模型来定位和检索个性化概念,它们的错误可能会传播到概念的调和.
然而,这些模块一旦获得,就很容易被更强大的模块所取代。

blocks.en:
Robustness under Noisy Interactions. Our benchmarks are constructed in a controlled manner, whereas real-world interactions can be noisier, e.g., with ambiguous references or low-quality images and descriptions.
We leave a systematic evaluation under such noisy interactions to future work.
blocks.zh:
强力在噪音相互作用下。 我们的基准是以一种控制的方式构建的,而现实世界的相互作用可以是噪声的,例如,使用模棱两可的参考或低质量的图像和描述。
在这种吵闹的相互作用下,我们把有系统的评价留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
Indirect Recovery from Incorrect Fusion. Concept fusion may occasionally merge two distinct concepts.
Although such a merge cannot be directly reverted, TAME-O can recover from it indirectly: benefiting from the attribute-level and time-aware memory organization, subsequent interactions progressively correct the affected concept memory with recent observations.
A direct mechanism to revert incorrect fusions is left to future work.
blocks.zh:
从不正确的融合中间接恢复. 概念组合有时可能合并两个截然不同的概念。
虽然这种合并不能直接恢复,但TAME-O可以间接地从中恢复:从属性层次和时间意识的记忆组织中受益,随后的相互作用逐渐用最近的观察来纠正受影响的概念记忆.
将不正确的核聚变还原的直接机制留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
Scalability and Privacy. The pairwise similarity computation in concept fusion grows quadratically with the number of concepts, although the number of MLLM invocations per fusion round is bounded by L L .
In large-scale deployment, this cost can be reduced by caching pairwise similarities and recomputing only the pairs involving recently updated concepts, or by approximate nearest-neighbor search.
Moreover, long-term personalized memory contains private user information, which calls for local storage and user-controlled deletion in practical deployment.
blocks.zh:
伸缩性和隐私. 概念聚变中的对偶相似性计算与概念数量成四倍增长,尽管每个聚变回合的MLLM引用次数以LL为界.
在大规模部署中,这种成本可以通过缓冲对偶的相似性来降低,并只重新计算涉及最近更新的概念的对偶,或者通过近距离近距离搜索来降低。
此外,长期个性化内存包含私人用户信息,这要求在实际部署中需要本地存储和用户控制的删除.

blocks.en: Appendix L Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 附录 L 宽度 影响

blocks.en: Since this study focuses on designing open-set personalized MLLM assistant, which is closely related to everyone’s daily life, it has broader impacts in both positive and negative aspects. On the positive side , open-set MLLM personalization can make future assistants more adaptive, user-aligned, and convenient in daily life. By automatically discovering and maintaining user-specific concepts through long-term interactions, such assistants can provide responses that are more context-aware and personalized, reducing the burden on users to manually register or describe every personal entity. This capability may benefit various real-world scenarios, such as daily assistance, education, accessibility support, elderly care, and long-term human AI collaboration, where understanding user-specific objects, people, pets, or environments is important for providing useful and grounded assistance. On the negative side , such systems may introduce risks from both misuse and the inherent limitations of MLLMs. For misuse, the ability to continuously acquire personalized concepts could be abused for intrusive profiling, unauthorized surveillance, or manipulative personalized content generation. For model limitations, our method may inherit hallucination and bias issues from the underlying MLLMs. It may generate responses that are not fully grounded in the input image, dialogue context, or stored personalized memories, and such hallucinations can be harmful in high-stakes scenarios. Moreover, biases from the vision encoder and language model may lead to unfair or stereotypical interpretations of user-specific entities. Therefore, open-set personalized MLLM assistants should be deployed with appropriate safeguards, usage restrictions, and careful evaluation, especially in sensitive applications.
blocks.zh: 由于这项研究的重点是设计开放式的个性化的MLLM助手,这与每个人的日常生活密切相关,因此在积极和消极两个方面都有更广泛的影响。 在积极的一面,开放的设定MLLM个性化可以使未来的助手在日常生活中更加适应性,用户相配合,更方便. 通过长期互动,自动发现并保持用户特有的概念,这些助手可以提供更具有上下文感和个人化的响应,减轻用户手动登记或描述每个个人实体的负担. 这种能力可能有利于各种现实世界的情景,例如日常援助、教育、无障碍支助、老年人护理和人类长期人工智能协作,在这种情形中,了解用户特定对象、人、宠物或环境对于提供有用和有依据的援助十分重要。 在消极的方面,这种系统可能带来滥用的风险,也可能带来MLLM的固有局限性。 对于滥用,不断获得个性化概念的能力可能被滥用于侵入性貌相、未经授权的监视或操纵性的个人化内容生成。 对于模型限制,我们的方法可能会继承基础MLLMs的幻觉和偏差问题. 它可能会产生不完全基于输入图像,对话背景,或存储的个性化记忆的响应,这种幻觉在高摄入场景中可能有害. 此外,视觉编码器和语言模型的偏差可能导致对用户特定实体的不公平或定型解释。 因此,应部署开放的个性化MLLM助理,并有适当的保障、使用限制和仔细评估,特别是在敏感应用方面。

blocks.en: Check for mismatches in Name , Species , Physical Appearance , or Core Attributes .
blocks.zh: 在名称、物种、物理外观或核心属性中检查不匹配。

blocks.en: If the Question describes an entity that is fundamentally different from a Candidate, they are NOT the same.
blocks.zh: 如果问题描述了一个与候选人根本不同的实体,它们就不一样。

blocks.en: If the Question explicitly mentions a candidate’s proper name, select that candidate unless species or stable identity details contradict it.
blocks.zh: 如果问题明确提到候选人的正确姓名,则选择该候选人,除非物种或稳定身份细节与该名字相矛盾。

blocks.en: Transient details (e.g., accessories, location, mood, pose, or activity) may differ from memory and are not enough by themselves to make a new concept; compare stable identity details (e.g., name, species, breed, color, or markings).
blocks.zh: 瞬间细节(如附件,位置,情绪,姿势,或活动)可能与内存不同,本身不足以形成新概念;比较稳定的身份细节(如名称,物种,品种,颜色,或标记).

blocks.en: If the tone of the Question is to introduce a new concept (e.g., a person, pet, or belonging), select “NEW_CONCEPT”.
blocks.zh: 如果提问的基调是引入一个新概念(例如人、宠物或归属),则选择“NEW_CONCEPT”。

blocks.en: Context might be similar, but specific details must match.
blocks.zh: 背景可能相似,但具体细节必须相符。

blocks.en: Use only the neutral candidate labels shown above. Do not infer identity from labels.
blocks.zh: 只使用上述中性候选人标签 。 不要从标签中推断身份。

blocks.en: If NO candidate is a strong match, select “NEW_CONCEPT”.
blocks.zh: 如果没有候选人是强烈的匹配者,请选择“NEW_CONCEPT”。

blocks.en: Conclude “SAME” only with clear identity evidence: the portraits show the same individual/object, or the memories share a distinctive name, model, or owner-specific identifier.
blocks.zh: 仅以明确的身份证据缔结“SAME”:肖像画显示的是相同的个人/对象,或记忆中有一个与所有人不同的名称、模型或标识符。

blocks.en: Generic category overlap is not enough: two cats or two similar-looking people can still be different entities.
blocks.zh: 一般类别重叠还不够:两只猫或两个相像的人仍然可以是不同的实体.

blocks.en: If both concepts have specific names, brands, models, colors, breeds, or personal details that differ, conclude “DIFFERENT”.
blocks.zh: 如果两个概念都有不同的具体名称、品牌、模型、颜色、品种或个人细节,则得出“不同”的结论。

blocks.en: A generic reference (e.g., “the cat”) matches a specific concept only when the visual evidence or distinctive memories strongly connect them.
blocks.zh: 一种通用的参考(如“猫”)只有在视觉证据或独特的记忆将它们紧密联系起来时,才与具体的概念相匹配。

blocks.en: Merge an unnamed fragment with few memories into the richer concept when its later details are compatible and no identity evidence contradicts it.
blocks.zh: 将一个没有名字的片段合并,很少记忆到更丰富的概念中,当其后来的细节是相容的,没有身份证据与之相矛盾.

blocks.en: Assume memories accumulate over time.
blocks.zh: 假设记忆会随着时间而累积。

blocks.en: Do not merge based on broad class, scene, pose, or activity alone.
blocks.zh: 不要仅仅根据广泛的阶级、场景、姿势或活动而合并。

blocks.en: Later memory fragments may omit the name.
blocks.zh: 后来的记忆片段可能会省略名称.

blocks.en: If the evidence is weak or ambiguous, favor “DIFFERENT”.
blocks.zh: 如果证据薄弱或模棱两可,则倾向于“不同”。
